verdict.rationale: Meta publishes code in the public meta-llama/llama-models GitHub repo and distributes weights through the official Hugging Face org, so the product can be inspected. However, the canonical repo states the license is the Llama Community License, not OSI open source. Downloads are gated behind accepting terms and an approval or signed-URL process, and community reports cite the 700M-MAU special-license clause as making it non-open-source. Missing for 10: an OSI-approved open license, ungated access to weights and source, and permission for all users regardless of scale.
